_note: Curated shipped model catalog. Canonical identity/capabilities are seeded from models.dev and reviewed at release; Pix-specific routing scores live separately in scorecard.json. This file never claims a model is callable: runtime availability comes only from backend bindings and probes. Packs map these canonical identities to private upstream model IDs without exposing those IDs here.

models.label: Claude Opus 5
models.notes: Anthropic flagship (shipped 2026-07-24, $5/$25 live). INSTA-UPGRADE for any Opus role: succeeds Opus 4.8 for accuracy-critical strategy/advisory. Near-Fable reasoning at Opus-tier price. See the model-refresh skill before re-grounding scores.

models.label: Claude Fable 5
models.notes: Frontier / top of BenchLM overall (SWE-bench Verified ~95%). The 'even Opus falls short' tier: one genuinely hard problem, no cost ceiling.

models.label: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: RETIRED 2026-07-24: superseded by Claude Opus 5 (same $5/$25 tier, strictly better). Kept for audit; available=false hides it from routing. Every Opus role now resolves to claude-opus-5.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5
models.notes: The production workhorse (Anthropic's own guidance: send most coding + knowledge work here). SWE-bench Pro 63.2, near-Opus at lower cost. $2/$10 intro through 2026-08-31, then $3/$15.

models.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Cheap Anthropic tier: classification, routing, extraction, cheap QA where accuracy still matters a little.

models.label: GPT-5.6 Sol
models.notes: OpenAI flagship (#3 overall on BenchLM). The cross-vendor adversarial reviewer of Claude-authored work: different blind spots.

models.label: GPT-5.6 Terra
models.notes: OpenAI mid-tier (production default equivalent). A cheaper cross-vendor option.

models.label: Gemini 3.1 Pro
models.notes: Google frontier + reasoning leader (GPQA ~94.1%), 1M+ context, cheapest of the frontier tier. A THIRD independent vendor for red-team/security.

models.label: Gemini 3.6 Flash
models.notes: Google price-performance middle, shipped 2026-07 as the insta-upgrade for 3.5 Flash: faster, stronger on internal evals, and CHEAPER output ($7.5 vs $9). The Flash-tier workhorse for prose (writing), fast QA (verify), and snappy interactive (fast-balanced).

models.label: Gemini 3.5 Flash
models.notes: RETIRED 2026-07: superseded by Gemini 3.6 Flash (faster, stronger, cheaper output). Kept for audit; available=false hides it from routing.

models.label: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite
models.notes: The volume floor (cheapest of any major vendor). High-volume breadth fan-out + parallel reads.

models.label: Qwen 3.5 9B (local)
models.notes: Local via Ollama. The best all-rounder that fits a 16GB machine (~6.6GB download, Apache 2.0, tools + thinking; current as of 2026-02). Free + private but slower than cloud, so it wins nothing by default and is an offline/private fallback. Bigger boxes can bump to gemma4:e4b (~9GB) or qwen3.5:27b. Needs `ollama pull qwen3.5:9b` + the ollama-bridge to expose it. NOTE: this is the ROUTER's local option; the memory watcher is a separate role but defaults to the same qwen3.5:9b so Ollama keeps one model resident for both.

models.label: GLM 5.2 (Ollama Cloud)
models.notes: Ollama Cloud long-horizon coding model. Access is owned by the local Ollama login and proxied through the local Ollama API; Pix stores no Ollama credential. Subscription usage is not modeled as per-token USD cost.

models.label: Kimi K3 (Ollama Cloud)
models.notes: RETIRED from routing 2026-07-31: not callable on default Ollama subscriptions — kimi-k3 is 'extra usage only' and 401s at call time even though `ollama list` shows it, so trusting the listing routed the overlord intent to a model the account cannot call. Superseded for Ollama-Cloud coding by kimi-k2.7-code:cloud and deepseek-v4-pro:cloud (both plan-included). Kept for audit; available=false hides it from routing. Re-enable by setting available=true once your plan carries extra-usage balance.
